messages:
carla (sec): quick ask — Airbrake support reached out asking for temporary access to debug a sudden error-rate spike on ingest-api. They want error logs + session traces for project:ingest-api. Can we grant restricted access with redaction? @leah
jon (eng): +1. We should absolutely avoid exposing raw PII. Proposal: support role with read-only permissions to errors/traces and server-side redaction for emails/phone/ip. Duration = 48h unless we need an extension.
leah (vendorops): noted. We'll need a short justification, exact scope, and duration to open the vendor access ticket. Also we require the signed MSA or a legal-approved exception.
mike (sre): thumbs up on limited role. Also please enable audit logging for the window. If any request bodies include PII we should strip or provide a sampled subset.
carla (sec): example role config to propose (minimal):
```
role: airbrake_support
permissions:
  - errors:read
  - traces:read
  - sessions:read
filters:
  - redact: [email, phone, ip, ssn]
duration: 48h
require_sso: true
require_audit: true
```
jon (eng): note — our session payloads sometimes include full request bodies; we should add `body: sample` or `body: redact` to avoid sending customer content. I can add a pre-redaction lambda if needed.
leah (vendorops): can you add the exact API path(s) they need? e.g., `/v1/errors`, `/v1/traces/:id` — more precise scoping makes approvals faster.
jon (eng): yes — only `/v1/errors` (read) and `/v1/traces/:id` (read). no write. session export endpoint only for traces tied to error IDs, and with body redacted.
sec-bot: Reminder: vendor access checklist — signed agreement, security questionnaire complete, minimum-privilege role, SSO, audit logs enabled. See https://intranet.redwood/security/vendor-access for the flow.
carla (sec): conditional approval: if vendor provides justification and Legal confirms MSA status, Sec approves 48h access with the role config above. If they request session request bodies, deny unless we have a specific business justification.
leah (vendorops): I'll open the VendorPortal ticket now and tag Legal + Jon for the justification. ETA ~2 hours.
mike (sre): after ticket is created ping me — I'll enable audit stream + create a short-lived AWS role for the access window. Also will snapshot logs before exposing anything. :white_check_mark:
jon (eng): added the justification + endpoint list to the ticket. Also linking a tiny code snippet for pre-redaction we can enable quickly:
```python
# pre-redact example (lambda)
def redact(payload):
    payload.pop('email', None)
    payload.pop('phone', None)
    payload['body'] = 'REDACTED'
    return payload
```
carla (sec): thanks. once Legal confirms MSA I'll flip the approval switch. If anyone needs an extension, make a new request with justification and a security review.
leah (vendorops): ticket created: https://vendorportal.redwood/req/4721 — tagged @legal, @jon, @carla. I'll update here when Legal + Sec sign off.
jon (eng): thanks — will stand by and help with any quick patches or config changes.
sec-bot: Automated note: New vendor access request 4721 created. Please ensure you upload the signed agreement to the ticket.
leah (vendorops): uploaded a copy of the signed MSA (redacted) and answered the security questionnaire. Legal marked as "reviewing".
carla (sec): Legal OK, Sec approves the 48h limited role. @mike please proceed with audit + short-lived creds.
mike (sre): done — audit enabled, creds issued with 48h TTL. Credentials delivered to Airbrake via the vendor portal link. Monitoring in place.
jon (eng): confirmed they only pulled the scoped endpoints and we saw no PII in exports. Closing on our side.
leah (vendorops): closing ticket now. thanks everyone! :tada:
